title: Star Wars Rebels
description: Set between the events of Star Wars: Episodes III and IV, the story unfolds during a dark time when the evil Galactic Empire is tightening its grip of power on the galaxy. Imperial forces have occupied a remote planet and are ruining the lives of its people. The motley but clever crew of the starship Ghost — cowboy Jedi Kanan, ace pilot Hera, street-smart teenager Ezra, the “muscle” Zeb, warrior firebrand Sabine, and cantankerous old astromech droid Chopper — is among a select few who are brave enough to stand against the Empire. Together, they will face threatening new villains, encounter colorful adversaries, embark on thrilling adventures, and become heroes with the power to ignite a rebellion.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 1x1
episodes_data.description: The rebel group intercepts an Imperial weapon shipment and unintentionally take on an android duo.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 1x2
episodes_data.description: Ezra and Zeb go to Lothal's market for provisions and to work on their relationship.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 1x3
episodes_data.description: The rebel crew undergoes a rescue mission only to face a powerful foe.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 1x4
episodes_data.description: The Rebels send Ezra on an undercover mission into the Imperial Academy to steal a decoder.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 1x5
episodes_data.description: While on a supply run, Hera and Sabine find themselves stranded but not alone in a seemingly abandoned locale.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 1x6
episodes_data.description: While disrupting Empire Day festivities in order to destroy a prototype TIE fighter, the crew learns a refugee has important information and must get him off-planet before the Imperials find him.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 1x7
episodes_data.description: Kanan and Ezra try to protect an Imperial deserter by distracting the Imperial forces.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 1x8
episodes_data.description: Ezra must face a great challenge as part of his growth as a member of the team.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 1x9
episodes_data.description: The crew are forced into transporting some unusual cargo after an issue with a new acquaintance.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 1x10
episodes_data.description: While attending a gathering for those who would oppose the Empire, the crew finds out something unexpected.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 1x11
episodes_data.description: As public awareness increases around Rebel activity, they target an important Imperial network.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 1x12
episodes_data.description: The team tries to get Kanan's location to free him.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 1x13
episodes_data.description: The crew has to go through many obstacles to save Kanan.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 2x1
episodes_data.description: Ahsoka sends the Rebel crew to find and recruit a war hero to their cause, but when they discover it is Captain Rex, trust issues put the mission at risk.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 2x2
episodes_data.description: Ezra and the others are starting to form friendships with the old Clone Troopers, but Kanan can't seem to bring himself to trust them. Will he feel differently when pressure from the Empire forces them to work together?

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 2x3
episodes_data.description: Ezra, Zeb, Sabine, and Chopper are on a mission to an abandoned medistation in search of supplies when an attack by two of Darth Vader's Inquisitors divides the team.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 2x4
episodes_data.description: In order to flee the pressure of the responsibility of being a rebel and a Jedi, Ezra goes on a rescue mission together with Chopper after they received a distress call. They are surprised to find out the ship in need belongs to Hondo Ohnaka. Hondo offers Ezra to join him.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 2x5
episodes_data.description: Since the rebels are in need of a new ship in order to overcome an Imperial blockade, Hera embarks on a dangerous mission to meet an eccentric starship engineer and manages to gain his trust. But will that be enough to get a ship from him?

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 2x6
episodes_data.description: On a mission to escort a courier with secret information vital to the rebel cause to a rendezvous point, Sabine must face off against her old friend and partner.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 2x7
episodes_data.description: A new Imperial ship captures Ezra, Commander Sato, and his crew, forcing Kanan and the clone to go undercover as stormtroopers to free the rebels.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 2x8
episodes_data.description: The rebels learn that the Inquisitors are seeking out Force-sensitive children, and they work together to protect the young ones from the Inquisitors' pursuit.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 2x9
episodes_data.description: As the Empire attacks the rebel fleet on Garel, Kanan, and Ezra return to Lothal and find a former prisoner with knowledge about Ezra's parents.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 2x10
episodes_data.description: During the early rebellion against the rule of the Galactic Empire, Princess Leia Organa of Alderaan is sent to the planet Lothal on a mission to provide ships for the rebel fleet. When the Empire initiates a lockdown, her plan is thrown into jeopardy

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 2x11
episodes_data.description: In need of new hyperspace routes due to Imperial pressure, the rebels find a shortcut but must first gain permission to use it.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 2x12
episodes_data.description: When the crew of the Ghost agrees to help two refugees who are revealed to be surviving Lasat, Zeb must come to terms with his past to help his people reach their new home.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 2x13
episodes_data.description: While on a mission to obtain fuel for the rebel fleet, the crew works to protect space creatures from the Mining Guild asteroid mining operation that threatens the creatures' lives.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 2x14
episodes_data.description: The rebels contact freedom fighter Cham Syndulla, who needs help to fight off the Imperial bombing attack on his planet. While coordinating a plan to overtake and steal the carrier that houses these Imperial bombers, the rebels discover that Cham may have a plan of his own.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 2x15
episodes_data.description: Zeb and Agent Kallus find themselves stranded on an ice planet after a failed Imperial ambush of the rebels. With Kallus injured from the escape pod crash, he and Zeb must work together to survive the harsh conditions.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 2x16
episodes_data.description: Kanan, Ezra, and Ahsoka return to the Jedi Temple on Lothal, seeking answers from Yoda about the Inquisitors’ ability to continually track the rebels.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 2x17
episodes_data.description: When Chopper gets left behind at an Imperial outpost, he forms an unlikely friendship with an Imperial droid, and discovers a base location for the rebels.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 2x18
episodes_data.description: Kanan, Ezra, and Ahsoka prepare to depart to unravel Vader’s secret, while the rebels find a way to fend off the predatory creatures that occupy the planet.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 2x19
episodes_data.description: After gaining information about the Sith, Kanan, Ezra, and Ahsoka battle the Inquisitors with the help of a new ally, but are overmatched when Vader arrives.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 3x1
episodes_data.description: Ezra, Sabine, Zeb, Chopper and Hera sets out to rescue Hondo Ohnaka, while Kanan finds an ancient force creature know as The Bendu.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 3x2
episodes_data.description: When Maul takes the crew of the Ghost hostage, Ezra and Kanan must pass a trial in order to recover an ancient Sith artifact to save them.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 3x3
episodes_data.description: With the rebellion in desperate need of pilots, Sabine goes undercover as an Imperial cadet to recruit defectors -- including the confident and gifted Wedge Antilles.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 3x4
episodes_data.description: Hera's rebel supply mission to Ryloth becomes personal when she and the Ghost crew brave overwhelming Imperial forces to recover a memento from her ancestral home.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 3x5
episodes_data.description: On a salvage mission led by Captain Rex, the Ghost crew is captured by a unit of old battle droids determined to fight one last battle to end the Clone Wars.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 3x6
episodes_data.description: Having lost contact with the Protectors of Concord Dawn, Sabine, Ezra, and Fenn Rau investigate and find the base occupied by Imperial Mandalorians.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 3x7
episodes_data.description: Ezra and Sabine team up to tame a rogue, young hotshot pilot and his crew who recklessly risk their lives in a fight to defend their home world from Imperial occupation.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 3x8
episodes_data.description: The rebels team with a pair of unscrupulous pirates to salvage a freighter full of weapons for the rebellion, but the mission ends up being far more dangerous than anticipated.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 3x9
episodes_data.description: Seeking information on a new Imperial weapon, Ezra and Kanan infiltrate the Imperial factory on Lothal, but must trust an unlikely ally to escape a lockdown.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 3x10
episodes_data.description: Maul returns, looking to finally unlock the secrets that he and Ezra desire.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 3x11
episodes_data.description: The crew returns to Geonosis in search of a missing rebel team sent to investigate suspicious activity there, and are surprised by what they find.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 3x12
episodes_data.description: After finding a missing rebel team member, the Ghost crew discovers another surprise on Geonosis, and work to conceal it from Imperial Forces.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 3x13
episodes_data.description: Zeb and Chopper bring a damaged droid found in the Atollon wilderness back to base, only to discover that the droid is a new Imperial probe programmed to spy on and destroy rebels.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 3x14
episodes_data.description: To help recruit her people to join the rebels, Sabine reluctantly agrees to learn to wield an ancient Mandalorian weapon but finds the challenge more difficult than expected.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 3x15
episodes_data.description: Hoping to get her family to help the rebels, Sabine returns home with Kanan and Ezra, and finds herself embroiled in her family's power struggle for Mandalore.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 3x16
episodes_data.description: Fearing that the identity of a rebel spy will soon be discovered by the Empire, the Rebels launch a plan to rescue him before he is caught.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 3x17
episodes_data.description: The Ghost crew must escort Senator Mon Mothma, now wanted by the Empire, to a meeting that can change the galaxy.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 3x18
episodes_data.description: Chopper and AP-5 team up to infiltrate an Imperial station to steal needed codes, but an Imperial specialist turns the droids against the crew to cause chaos.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 3x19
episodes_data.description: Reacting to a vision of Maul, Ezra defies Hera and Kanan to travel to a remote planet in hopes of stopping the former Sith lord from carrying out his plans.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 3x20
episodes_data.description: In final preparations for their attack on Lothal, Phoenix Squadron's plans are disrupted when Grand Admiral Thrawn discovers their location.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 3x21
episodes_data.description: Trapped on Atollon with the rebel base under siege, Hera and Kanan fight to keep the squadron alive, as Ezra attempts to rally help from an unexpected source.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 4x1
episodes_data.description: Sabine leads Ezra, Kanan and an army of her fellow Mandalorians back to her home world to rescue her father from the clutches of the Empire.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 4x2
episodes_data.description: When Sabine discovers the Empire has resurrected a devastating weapon she created and plans to use it against her people, she must decide whether to destroy it or use it herself.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 4x3
episodes_data.description: As members of the Rebel Alliance, Ezra and the Ghost crew must accept a mission to spy on an Imperial outpost they would rather destroy.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 4x4
episodes_data.description: After being separated from Hera and Kanan, Ezra and Sabine join the desperate quest of Saw Gerrera to hunt down the Empire's elusive secret super weapon.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 4x5
episodes_data.description: Ezra and the Ghost crew are called back to Lothal when a new Imperial threat rises.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 4x6
episodes_data.description: Ezra and Sabine steal an Imperial prototype TIE fighter but must rely on some unexpected help to escape from Thrawn.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 4x7
episodes_data.description: Tracked back to their hidden base by a mysterious Imperial agent, the rebels must trust some seemingly dangerous native creatures, who are far more than meets the eye.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 4x8
episodes_data.description: Desperate to contact Rebel command, the Ghost crew pirates a mining vehicle with long range communications gear, but the Empire arrives to spoil their plans.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 4x9
episodes_data.description: Hera leads a courageous attack against Grand Admiral Thrawn's forces, but when things go awry, her battle to win must become a daring escape if she is to survive.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 4x10
episodes_data.description: The Ghost Crew infiltrates the Imperial headquarters on Lothal to save one of their own.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 4x11
episodes_data.description: Reeling from a devastating loss, the Ghost crew rallies together to find a new purpose and resolve.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 4x12
episodes_data.description: Ezra leads the Ghost crew back to the Jedi temple on Lothal where they discover that the Empire has diabolical plans for the powerful secrets it holds.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 4x13
episodes_data.description: While the other rebels engage the Imperial forces outside the Jedi temple, Ezra gains access inside and experiences a revelation.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 4x14
episodes_data.description: The Ghost hatches a plan to free Lothal, though a traitor may be in their midst.

episodes_data.title: Star Wars Rebels 4x15
episodes_data.description: Ezra and the Ghost crew look to complete their ultimate mission: to liberate Lothal from the clutches of the Empire.
